name: fluidd
title: Fluidd
description: Swaps SM's outdated Fluidd for the current upstream release. You get input-shaper graphs, integrated config/G-code editors, tool-colour preview, modern mesh viz. Uninstall restores the SM-shipped copy automatically; no nginx config touched.
tagline: Modern Fluidd v1.37.3: replaces the stock SM build.
author: bespoked

config.label: Fluidd port
config.hint: Auto-assigned. Make Fluidd primary to serve it on port 80.

config.label: Hide unused tool buttons
config.hint: Off by default. On, the tool row shows one button per lane the printer actually has, instead of all 32 the firmware keeps room for. The tools are still there and a macro can still call them. Reload the page after changing this.
